thread_analysis.thread_summary: This thread is a duplicate/overlapping capture of the same Hoshiden Corporation (contacts Yusuke Nomura, Masaki Hori) Bluetooth SIG certification engagement already fully documented in thread_0266 — the same wristband activity tracker module project, the same module-vendor DN acquisition strategy discussion, the same RF PHY test scope reduction question, and the same GAP/LL cross-layer Consistency Check inconsistency requiring the two-stage registration strategy (module-level DN via RF PHY test, then customer-side Include-without-modification) — through to final RF PHY test completion, registration Submission, and Compliance Folder preparation (November 2024).
all_questions_found: (Already documented in thread_0266_case_01) Does a 'Default' DN display or Q30-prefixed QDID cause any disadvantage, and what registration structure best serves OEM customers?
(Already documented in thread_0266_case_02) Can RF PHY test scope be reduced to only the PHY mode actually implemented?
(Already documented in thread_0266_case_03) How do we avoid GAP-layer protocol testing that only the stack vendor can realistically perform, given this QDID combination's inherent inconsistency?
